items.source: Note that a decoded response body is not exposed at this level since the body may not have been decoded and consumed yet. Subtypes EntityExchangeResult and FluxExchangeResult provide access to a decoded response entity and a decoded (but not consumed) response body respectively.
items.translation: 请注意，在此级别不会暴露解码后的响应体，因为该响应体可能尚未被解码和消费。子类型EntityExchangeResult和FluxExchangeResult分别提供对解码后的响应实体和解码后（但未消费）的响应体的访问。

items.source: Note: If the request content has not been consumed for any reason yet, use of this method will trigger consumption.
items.translation: 注意： 如果请求内容尚未因任何原因被消费，使用此方法将触发消费。

items.source: Note: If the response content has not been consumed yet, use of this method will trigger consumption.
items.translation: 注意： 如果尚未消耗响应内容，使用此方法将触发消耗。

items.source: Execute the given Runnable, catch any AssertionError, log details about the request and response at ERROR level under the class log category, and after that re-throw the error.
items.translation: 执行给定的 `Runnable`，捕获任何 `AssertionError`，在类日志类别下以 ERROR 级别记录请求和响应的详细信息，然后重新抛出该错误。

items.source: Return a JsonConverterDelegate based on the configured codecs.
items.translation: 返回一个基于配置的编解码器生成的JsonConverterDelegate。

items.source: Return the HTTP status code as an HttpStatusCode value.
items.translation: 返回 HTTP 状态码为 `HttpStatusCode` 值。

items.source: Return a JsonConverterDelegate based on the configured codecs. Mainly for internal use from AssertJ support classes.
items.translation: 根据配置的编解码器返回一个JsonConverterDelegate接口。主要用于 AssertJ 支持类的内部使用。

items.source: Return the method of the request.
items.translation: 返回请求的方法。

items.source:
Return the result from the mock server exchange, if applicable, for
further assertions on the state of the server response.
items.translation: 返回来自模拟服务器交换的结果（如果适用），以便对服务器响应的状态进行进一步的断言。

items.source: Return the request headers sent to the server.
items.translation: 返回发送到服务器的请求头。

items.source: Return response cookies received from the server.
items.translation: 返回从服务器接收到的响应 Cookie。

items.source: Return the response headers received from the server.
items.translation: 返回从服务器接收到的响应头。

items.source: Return the original URI template used to prepare the request, if any.
items.translation: 返回用于准备请求的原始 URI 模板（如有）。

items.source: Return the URI of the request.
items.translation: 返回请求的 URI。

items.source: IllegalStateException - if the request body has not been fully written.
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果请求体尚未完全写入。

items.source: IllegalStateException - if the response has not been fully read.
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果响应尚未完全读取。

items.source: Return the raw request body content written through the request.
items.translation: 返回通过请求写入的原始请求体内容。

items.source: Return the raw request body content written to the response.
items.translation: 返回写入响应的原始请求体内容。

items.translation: `toString` 在类 `Object` 中
